intent: Renew the household Jio prepaid every 28 days: buy the cheapest Jio India 28-day unlimited-calls plan (about ₹239-299). If no 28-day plan fits, buy the cheapest talktime top-up instead.
Monthly medicine refill: buy a ₹500 Apollo Pharmacy India gift card (redeemed in the Apollo 24|7 app).
When an international trip shows up in my Google Calendar or a booking email, propose an eSIM for the destination; buy only after I approve.
Send mom a small food treat: a ₹50 Swiggy Money (or Zomato if Swiggy is unavailable) gift card.

Order 2 cans of Diet Coke on Swiggy Instamart for delivery to the BKC Bloom hotel address. Pick the cheapest in-stock option, add nothing else to the order, and skip the order if the total would go over the ceiling. Deliver to my Bloom BKC address.
Buy a ₹250 Swiggy Money India gift card (it is auto-redeemed into the household Swiggy balance).
